response.sql: WITH eq_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry, AVG(s.humepct) AS avg_hum FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment s ON s.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM eq_avg), above AS (SELECT ea.equipregistry, ea.avg_hum FROM eq_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.avg_hum > o.all_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_mean FROM above) SELECT a.equipregistry AS equip_ref, a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, a.avg_hum - o.all_avg AS exceed_overall, a.avg_hum - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean FROM above a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE o.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
